meta.title: The Taxicab Number Game
meta.description: The Taxicab Number Game — discover the hidden mathematics behind taxi number plates, starting with 1729.

home.footer: An interactive journey into the mathematics of taxicab numbers.

game.heading: Spot the Taxicab Number!
game.prompt: One of these taxis is hiding a mathematical secret. Can you find the number that can be expressed as the sum of two positive cubes in two different ways?
game.feedbackSuccess: Well spotted! Continue to uncover its mathematical secret.
game.feedbackIncorrect: Not quite. {{plate}} is not the taxicab number. Try another taxi!

progressiveReveal.heading: Discover the representations
progressiveReveal.prompt: Can you discover two different ways to express this number as the sum of two positive cubes?
progressiveReveal.representationRevealed: Representation {{count}} of the cube sum equations has been revealed.
progressiveReveal.completion1729: Congratulations! You discovered why 1729 is the smallest positive integer that can be expressed as the sum of two positive cubes in two distinct ways.
progressiveReveal.completionGeneric: Congratulations! You discovered that {{target}} can be expressed as the sum of two positive cubes in two distinct ways — a member of OEIS sequence A001235.
progressiveReveal.equationHiddenAriaLabel: Unknown cubed plus unknown cubed equals {{target}}
